jobs.title: Head of Growth Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

About the Role

The Head of Growth Marketing will help more of the right people find Sarvam, try it, understand its value, and keep using it. This role owns the journey from first visit to real product usage. It means knowing who is coming to Sarvam, what they are looking for, where they get stuck, and what makes them come back. The work is not just to drive traffic, but to make every step clearer, simpler, and more useful for builders and teams using the platform.This person will work closely with Product, Sales, Developer Relations, and Content to improve how Sarvam reaches people and how people experience the product. The goal is to make growth less dependent on big launch moments and more consistent every week.

What You’ll Do

  • Category narrative & positioning. Define how the market understands what we do, who it's for, and why it matters. Own positioning across developers, enterprises, and consumers.

  • PLG funnel ownership. Own the developer journey end-to-end: discovery → signup → first successful API call → habitual usage → paid conversion → team expansion. Instrument it, experiment on it, compound it.

  • Developer adoption. Grow API usage and open-weight model adoption. Own developer evangelism, documentation SEO, Hugging Face presence, arXiv and Papers with Code visibility, and the technical content flywheel.

  • AI discoverability. Own how we show up in LLM training pipelines and AI-powered search

  • Paid & organic acquisition. Build top-of-funnel through content, community, events, and targeted paid where it makes sense. Quality of signup matters more than volume.

  • Lifecycle & activation. Design onboarding, in-product nudges, and lifecycle programs that move developers from signup → first call → habit → revenue.

  • Product launches. Lead GTM for every model and product release from launch brief to post-launch usage impact.

  • Brand & thought leadership. Place our founders and research in the rooms that matter - AI summits, policy circles, global benchmarks, tier-1 media.

  • Team building. Hire and develop a 4–8 person team across performance, content, community, developer relations, and ops.

  • Marketing ops & AI-native workflows. Run a lean, leveraged team. Own martech stack, attribution, and growth analytics. Use AI to compress every cycle.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in growth marketing with 3+ years leading a team

  • Owned a PLG or self-serve developer/SMB funnel at material scale - and have the activation, retention, and conversion numbers to prove it improved under you

  • Built demand programs that drove measurable usage and revenue - not awareness vanity metrics

  • Marketed to developers or technical buyers with quantified outcomes

  • Fluent in modern AI tools for creative, content, targeting, and analytics

Why Sarvam?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

  • Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

  • High ownership and high impact, from day one

  • Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems

  • You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

About the Role

The Solution Architect is the trusted technical advisor who bridges what Sarvam builds and what the client needs. You will work alongside the sales and GTM team to understand prospect requirements, translate them into compelling technical narratives, and ensure every deal moves forward with clarity and momentum. You own the technical relationship with the customer's technology decision maker, end-to-end through the pre-sales cycle.

This is not a support role. You will be in client meetings from day one, shaping how enterprises understand and evaluate Sarvam's AI platform. You will build demos, craft proposals, run pilots, and work directly with product and engineering teams to close the gap between what a client asks for and what Sarvam can deliver. The problems you work on will span voice AI, document intelligence, multilingual agents, and enterprise-grade API platforms.

If you are someone who can hold a technical conversation with an engineering lead and a business conversation with a CXO in the same meeting, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the pre-sales cycle for assigned accounts: from discovery and qualification through to technical proposal and pilot design

  • Build and deliver compelling product demos tailored to each prospect's industry, use case, and technical environment

  • Create proposals, RFP/RFI responses, solution architecture documents, and commercial models in collaboration with the sales lead

  • Work with Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) and product teams to scope technical feasibility and define pilot success criteria

  • Develop a deep understanding of Sarvam's full product stack: Samvaad, Studio, Akshar, and the API platform (TTS, STT, document digitisation)

  • Build reusable demos, case studies, battlecards, and proposal templates that scale across accounts and lift the rest of the team

  • Track and communicate client feedback and feature gaps back to product teams with clarity and context

  • Support deal reviews and pipeline discussions with data, timelines, and risk flags

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years in a pre-sales, solutions consulting, technical sales, or product-facing GTM role, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology

  • Strong communication skills: you can explain complex technical products in simple, outcome-oriented language

  • Comfort with technical concepts: APIs, cloud infrastructure, AI/ML workflows. You don't need to write code, but you need to understand how systems connect

  • Experience building proposals, decks, or solution documents for enterprise buyers

  • High attention to detail: proposals go out clean, demos run without surprises, timelines are tracked

  • Willingness to learn fast and go deep on Sarvam's product and technology stack

Bonus Points

  • Prior exposure to AI/ML products, conversational AI, or language technology

  • Experience working with Indian enterprise or government clients

  • Familiarity with Indian language ecosystems and the specific challenges of multilingual AI deployment

  • Background in consulting, business analysis, or solutions engineering

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

Why Sarvam?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

  • Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

  • High ownership and high impact, from day one

  • Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems

  • You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

jobs.title: Business Development - Education & Healthcare
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

About the Role

We are looking for a Business Development lead with 3-5 years of experience to grow Sarvam's presence across the education and healthcare sectors. You will own relationships across universities, government departments, hospitals, and B2B companies in both verticals, with a focus on identifying where Sarvam's AI platform can drive real institutional impact. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of AI and two of India's most important sectors.

What You'll Do

  • Build and manage relationships with private and government universities, state and central education departments, hospital chains, and public health bodies

  • Identify and develop opportunities with B2B education and healthcare companies, startups, and government institutions

  • Own the full business development cycle: outreach, discovery, solution shaping, proposal development, and partnership closure

  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and marketing teams to tailor Sarvam's AI solutions to institutional needs across both verticals

  • Navigate the procurement processes, RFPs, empanelment cycles, and multi-stakeholder approval workflows

  • Track and report on pipeline development, partnership progress, and sector traction

  • Represent Sarvam at education and healthcare conferences, government forums, and industry events

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years of B2B business development or partnerships experience, preferably in education, healthcare, or a deep-tech company

  • Proven track record of building relationships with institutional or government clients

  • Strong understanding of how Indian institutions procure technology: university purchasing cycles, hospital IT decision-making, government tender processes etc.

  • Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills across diverse institution types

  • Ability to navigate long engagement cycles and multi-stakeholder environments

  • Clear, confident communicator, written and verbal

  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment

jobs.title: Solution Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

About the Role

We are looking for a Solution Specialist with 3–5 years of experience to serve as the critical bridge between Sarvam's products and its clients. You will own end-to-end deployment of Sarvam's AI solutions at client locations — translating product capabilities into real-world outcomes. This role sits at the intersection of technology, client relationship management, and delivery, and requires someone who is equally comfortable in a boardroom and a server room.

What You'll Do

• Own the end-to-end deployment of Sarvam's AI products at client sites, from onboarding through go-live

• Act as the primary bridge between Sarvam's product and engineering teams and client stakeholders

• Understand client requirements deeply and translate them into clear, actionable deployment plans

• Manage on-site and remote implementation activities, coordinating across internal teams and client IT/ops teams

• Troubleshoot and resolve technical and operational issues during and after deployment

• Gather client feedback and relay product insights to internal teams to drive continuous improvement

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key client contacts to ensure long-term success and satisfaction

• Document deployment processes, configurations, and best practices for knowledge sharing

What We're Looking For

• 3–5 years of experience in solutions delivery, implementation, or technical consulting roles

• Strong understanding of AI/ML products or enterprise SaaS deployments

• Hands-on experience managing client-side deployments and integrations

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to work across technical and non-technical audiences

• Structured problem-solver who can diagnose issues quickly and drive resolution under pressure

• Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with high ownership

• Willingness to travel to client locations as required

jobs.title: Engagement Manager, Chanakya
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

About the Role

Engagement Manager is a senior client-facing role in the vertical. You own pipeline development, account strategy, and long-term engagement management. This is a builder role for someone who understands the procurement landscape, can engage at the CXO and technical leadership level, and can convert complex AI capability into funded, deployable programmes.

What You'll Do

• Own the day-to-day management of active client engagements, from scoping and alignment through to operational handover and adoption

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients across the engagement lifecycle; manage expectations proactively and honestly

• Translate client operational problems into precise briefs that deployment and engineering teams can act on

• Track delivery against commitments; surface risks early and drive resolution without waiting for escalation

• Work with Strategic Deployment Engineers to ensure what is being built reflects what the client actually needs

• Support pipeline development: account mapping, stakeholder outreach, and PoC scoping

• Build and maintain working relationships with mid-to-senior client stakeholders; grow account depth over time

• Surface ground-level observations back to the vertical as market intelligence

What We're Looking For

• 4–6 years of professional experience; foundational background at a top-tier consulting firm strongly preferred — with a track record of owning complex analytical work, structuring ambiguous problems, and being accountable for outcomes

• At least 2 years in strategic or complex enterprise GTM, account management, or programme delivery — where you owned client relationships, not just supported them

• Comfort operating in long-cycle, relationship-driven environments where trust is built over months, not deals

• Strong written and verbal communication, able to hold a room with senior stakeholders and write briefs that people act on

• Familiarity with GenAI or ML concepts sufficient to engage credibly with technical teams and translate capability to clients

• Experience in or adjacent to defence, government, critical infrastructure and complex enterprises is a plus

Signals We Look For

• You've owned something - a client, a mandate - and driven it to a conclusion without being

managed to do it

• You've had to deliver a hard message to a client or stakeholder, done it early, and held the

relationship

• You think in structures. You make complex problems legible and actionable for the people who

need to move on them

• You've worked across functions — engineering, finance, policy, or operations — and made thing happen without formal authority

• Experience at a top-tier consulting firm; owning complex analytical problem-solving, structuring ambiguous mandates, and being accountable for outcomes is strongly valued.

Who You Are

• You treat client ownership as a baseline, not a virtue — if the engagement is in trouble, it's your problem to fix

• You are direct; you say what you actually think, including to people more senior than you

• You are comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely energised by environments where the answer isn't obvious

• You move with urgency and bring others with you through influence, not authority

Why Sarvam?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

• Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

• High ownership and high impact, from day one

• Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems

• You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.
